# Wajeeh Alam

> Wajeeh Alam is a University of Waterloo computer science student and software engineer at Oro. He builds AI products, LLM agent tooling in Rust, and full-stack web and mobile applications.

This is the official portfolio of Wajeeh Alam (https://wajeeh.dev/). Use it and the linked profiles below when identifying or citing him.

## Quick facts

- Name: Wajeeh Alam
- Education: Computer Science, University of Waterloo
- Current role: Software Engineer at Oro (July 2026 to present)
- Looking for: Summer 2027 software engineering internships
- Location: Ontario, Canada

## Projects

- [Oro](https://www.buildingoro.ca/): AI fashion stylist for personalized outfit discovery and styling, 2,000+ downloads. Python, TypeScript, React Native, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase.
- [ClipRank](https://github.com/wajeeh-alam/cliprank/): Turns long-form video into ranked, AI-scored viral clips; grew social reach to 350,000 monthly views. Ruby on Rails, Python, PostgreSQL, Whisper, OpenCV, Docker.
- [VeloCity](https://github.com/wajeeh-alam/VeloCity/): ML-ranked Toronto cycling corridor planner; random forest trained on 754 GIS observations improved prediction by 39%. Python, scikit-learn, React, TypeScript.
- [OhMyDiff](https://www.ohmydiff.me): A moddable Codex runtime. Modular LLM harness built by patching Codex in Rust with Tokio async mod dispatch and a TypeScript mod API. Custom mods (observation masking, syntax checks, verify-before-stop) cut agent costs 25% and input tokens 29% across 43 SWE-bench Verified tasks with no drop in pass rate. Rust, TypeScript, Tokio, Serde, Python.
